paragraphs: A finish can show damage while the layer beneath it remains enclosed. We will review accessible material and explain where another opening or evaluation is needed. Share source repairs and earlier cleanup so the proposed work reflects the condition now present.

paragraphs: Share where water entered, when it was discovered, and what has been repaired. We will identify accessible findings and limits beneath coverings or behind fixed components. Source correction and restoration of the resulting wet material will remain separate tasks.

sections.title: Perform extraction and drying

sections.title: Mold remediation in DeSoto: establish the material scope
paragraphs: Share assessment documents, source repairs, and prior cleanup. We will identify accessible findings and questions requiring further review. A visible area does not establish every concealed layer, and stopping a leak does not remove affected components.

sections.title: Perform the defined remediation

sections.title: Track the requirements before closure

sections.title: Sewage backup cleanup in DeSoto: review the original contact

sections.title: Review changes and final items
